title: Plugin API
steps: Everything works as before: ⌘P, ⌘⇧P and Show history now come from plugins on the public plugin API.
Show history of this note, then drag the History panel's title into a window: it opens there as a tab, and drops on an edge split the window, as for notes. Or run ⌘⇧P, Open History in a window.
Open user settings and add `"plugins.disabled": ["history"]`, then reload. The history commands are gone from ⌘⇧P. Remove it and reload to bring them back.
Try `"plugins.disabled": ["commandBar.notes"]`: ⌘P opens an empty bar that says its plugins are off, and `>` still lists commands.
Open default settings: `plugins.disabled` is listed with the rest.
